class.envell.knight.desc: Melee. High health and damage. Ability: shield dash.
class.envell.mage.desc: Magic. Ability: fire wave in a cone in front of you.
class.envell.thief.desc: Stealth and speed. Ability: invisibility (can hide a nearby ally).
class.envell.engineer.desc: Support. Ability: a turret that shoots monsters, and item repair.
class.envell.bard.desc: Support. Ability: hypnotize enemies, buff and recharge allies.
message.envell.choose_hint: You are in Envell! Choose a class. The choice is permanent. If you closed the menu, reopen it with /envell class. Ability on the R key.
message.envell.only_envell: Classes only work in the world of Envell
message.envell.left: You returned to the real world
message.envell.class_locked: Your class is already chosen and cannot be changed.
message.envell.greed_stage2: The Chest of Greed has awakened!
message.envell.greed_stage3: The Chest of Greed has turned into a monster!
